user.title: Set up Log Doctor
user.description: Log Doctor scans your Home Assistant log, matches problems against a built-in knowledge base and (optionally) a live GitHub search, and reports what it finds. It never changes your configuration.

data.enable_github_lookup: Look up unmatched issues on GitHub
data.github_token: GitHub personal access token (optional, raises rate limits)
data.report_retention_days: Days to keep old report files on disk
data.include_supervisor_logs: Also check Supervisor, Host, and add-on logs (Home Assistant OS/Supervised only)
